_inspectorSnowReport.Report: Friday, April 3, 5:30 a.m. Kabooom! Our double-whammy storm delivered the goods! We’ve received 30 inches of snow since Tuesday, including 15 inches in the last 24 hours and 3 inches overnight. The sun returns today with temperatures in the 20s under partly cloudy skies. Lingering snow showers are possible this morning. The storm brought wet, heavy snow to the mountain earlier this week but finished with a healthy blast of light, low-density powder. Grab your boards and come play in the fluff! Please take caution while out skiing and riding – spring conditions exist and coverage is thin in many areas. Protect yourself (and your gear) by respecting all rope lines. Advanced skills are required on Powderhorn and Apex Express terrain. Eagle Express is closed along with Sunshine Bowl. Summit Express may be delayed this morning as patrol conducts avalanche mitigation work. The pond is now in place for Saturday’s Solidaze Pond Skim Beach Party. Get a sneak peek at the action today when Solitude employees test drive the pond. Temperatures were in the teens last night, so the water is going to be extra chilly today — expect top performance from our staff!
